_about: Period corrections to upstream's monsters, items and quests (levels, spots, prices, rewards), applied at every start by deploy/bin/mob_fixes.py (run by world_fixes.py). Each entry names a Mob row by Mob_ID, the NpcTemplate rows of a TemplateId, an ItemTemplate row by Id_nb or a DataQuest row by ID; the row changes only while it holds every expect value (upstream's), so the owner's own changes stay. Every entry says why, with its source.

fixes.name: Agisthil
fixes.why: Level 11 "Entry Into Tomorrow": the Allakhazam bestiary (2002-09-21) gives Agisthil "Minimum Level: 10 Maximum Level: 10" at "52k, 17k" (owner 2026-10-10: the period level); upstream has 12.

fixes.name: Agisthil
fixes.why: Agisthil's template, as his Mob row: Allakhazam bestiary 2002-09-21, "Minimum Level: 10 Maximum Level: 10".

fixes.name: Frund
fixes.why: Frund's template (his Mob row takes its level from it): the Allakhazam bestiary (2002-09-21) gives Frund "Minimum Level: 10 Maximum Level: 10" at "52k, 17k" (owner 2026-10-10: the period level).

fixes.name: Frund
fixes.why: The 2001-2002 walkthrough and its comments have both thieves at the red dwarf camp (Black Mountains South 53899, 17267, where Agisthil stands): "Frund and Agisthil spawn frequently near" the shaman; the bestiary (2002-09-21) has both at "52k, 17k". Upstream put Frund far west of the camp (owner 2026-10-10: move him beside Agisthil). The spot is Agisthil's mirrored across Shaman Aslis, so the two thieves flank the shaman: 157 units from Agisthil, 78 from the shaman (as Agisthil is), 159 or more from every other camp mob; Z is the shaman's, the nearest camp mob's. His RoamingRange (200) stays.

fixes.name: Cloudy Green Stone
fixes.why: "Zombie Problem" (level 4, Gronyr Gloyw outside Prydwen Keep): the Allakhazam page as archived 2004-11-01 says he gives "a cloudy green stone (worth about 50 copper)" for each rotting hog tail; upstream's reward has price 0, so a merchant pays nothing. Price 100 sells for 50 copper at item_sell_ratio 50 (owner 2026-10-11).

fixes.name: Cloudy Green Stone
fixes.why: The stone Gronyr Gloyw trades for each rotting hog tail in "Zombie Problem" (the other stone entry is the copy upstream's final reward handed too, which players may still carry). Allakhazam's item page (archived 2003-02-12 to 2004-12-26): "Stone is worth 50 copper when you sell it.", Albion, 0.00 lbs, level 4; price 100 sells for 50 copper at item_sell_ratio 50 (owner 2026-10-11: only one of his two stones sold). Model 113 is the client's "Green Gem" (objects.csv); upstream's 229 is the cloth dyes' bottle.

fixes.name: Lady Leana
fixes.why: Allakhazam (archived 2004-10-14): "just kill her ... and she will drop a Silver Chain"; upstream's generator made two templates of the item from the guide's "You receive ..." line and put both in the final reward, which DataQuest hands in full, so the quest gave two (owner 2026-10-11: two Belts of Animation from Cleric Mulgrut). Kept: the realm template, which delves "Classic quest reward (Lady Leana)"; the plain one delves "Classic quest reward ((quest item))".

fixes.why: Allakhazam (archived 2004-10-14): bring Stonemason Harwin one chert "and he will make you a weapon: Thin Chert = flint dirk, Flat Chert = flint knife, Round chert = flinthead club". Upstream's trade (classic-quests.json) makes that weapon, then the final reward handed all three flint weapons as well, so each chert gave four. The trade's weapon is kept; the final reward goes.
